title: Hallelujah
hook: The chord that makes Hallelujah *break your heart*

chords.name: F
chords.text: *F*, the IV, in C major. Gentle and open.

chords.name: G
chords.text: *G*, the V. You expect home, C major…

chords.name: Am
chords.text: …but it lands on *A minor*. Comfort denied.

chords.name: E7
chords.text: *E7*: its G♯ isn't in C. It drags you toward A minor.

question: Which version wrecks you most: Cohen, Buckley or Cale? 👇
